page_title: LANDR Composer - AI Chord Progression Generator | LANDR

summary.name: LANDR Composer
summary.one_liner: LANDR Composer is an AI chord progression and MIDI generator plugin for creating chords, basslines, melodies, and arpeggios inside a DAW.
use_cases: generate chord progressions without music theory
create basslines and melodies as starting points
build arpeggio patterns for a track
sketch song ideas with scenes and song mode
drag MIDI patterns into a DAW project
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI assistant that generates chord progressions and individual chords, and edits them via a chord progression guide. It creates MIDI sequences for chords, basslines, melodies, and arpeggios, with customizable modifiers such as polyphony and humanization. Users can edit MIDI in a piano roll, use stock sounds, and sync with a DAW or drag MIDI patterns directly into a project. Scenes and Song Mode are offered for organizing multiple ideas into a full composition.
notable: Included with LANDR Studio subscription, starting at USD $8.25/mo
Drag-and-drop MIDI patterns into a DAW
Plugin formats: VST3, AU, AAX on macOS; VST3, AAX on Windows
Chord progression guide for editing and refining harmonic sequences
caveats: Requires a LANDR Studio subscription (starting at USD $8.25/mo) and is not presented as a standalone free product
macOS requires 10.14 or higher; Windows requires Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
